# The Shade Store

> Custom window treatment retailer offering roller shades, roman shades, solar shades, cellular shades, drapery, and blinds with motorized, blackout, and cordless options made in the USA.

The Shade Store specializes in custom window coverings with room-specific solutions for bedrooms, bathrooms, and kitchens. They feature energy-efficient designs, light-filtering and blackout options, and integration with Lutron motorization systems using premium materials like Sunbrella fabrics.

## Key Topics

- Roller Shades
- Roman Shades
- Solar Shades
- Cellular Shades
- Blackout Window Treatments
- Motorized Window Treatments
- Light Filtering Shades
- Cordless Window Treatments
- Woven Wood Shades
- Custom Drapery
- Energy Efficient Solutions
- Sunbrella Fabrics
- Lutron Integration
- Made in USA

- [Window Treatments & Custom Window Coverings](https://www.theshadestore.com/window-treatments): Primary catalog of custom window treatments, shades, blinds, and drapes
- [Types of Window Treatments by Collection](https://www.theshadestore.com/collections): Main collections page featuring motorized, blackout, and cordless options

## Product Customization

- [Roller Shades | Customize](https://www.theshadestore.com/shades/roller-shades/custom-roller-shades/customize?color=grey&material=Bond): Roller shade customization tool with Bond material and Lutron integration

## Room-Specific Solutions

- [Custom Bedroom Window Treatments](https://www.theshadestore.com/collections/bedroom-window-treatments): Bedroom-specific treatments including roller shades and blackout options
- [Custom Bathroom Window Treatments](https://www.theshadestore.com/collections/bathroom-window-treatments): Bathroom treatments featuring moisture-resistant and Sunbrella options
- [Custom Kitchen Window Treatments](https://www.theshadestore.com/collections/kitchen-window-treatments): Kitchen window solutions with solar shades and Sunbrella Ventana fabrics
